(2) sex column had case variants ('FEMALE', 'MALE') which were normalized to lowercase. (3) 2 exact duplicate rows were removed. After cleaning, computed average body mass per species: Adelie: 3609.48 g, Chinstrap: 3775.00 g, Gentoo: 5211.67 g.
